name: NIST AI 600-1: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework — Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
description: NIST AI 600-1 (final, July 2024) is a cross-sectoral companion Profile to the AI RMF 1.0 that enumerates 12 generative-AI risk categories and 200+ voluntary suggested actions keyed to AI RMF Govern/Map/Measure/Manage subcategories (e.g., GV-1.6, MS-2.7, MG-2.4). It is guidance, not regulation, so mappings reflect alignment-to-suggested-actions rather than mandatory conformity. The agent-responsibility-boundary caveat applies throughout: AKSI controls own the agent-runtime slice (identity, action authorization, isolation, output/security evaluation, kill-switch, audit) while organization-wide o
jurisdiction: us-federal (NIST, voluntary; cross-referenced by US federal AI policy and procurement, and adopted internationally as guidance)
